out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the cookline hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM provided hand soap at cookline hand sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw pork on shelf above cooked tofu in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved raw pork to bottom shelf. CFM will reeducate staff on proper storage order of foods in equipment.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cut cabbage, bean sprouts, cooked pork, cooked chicken.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM and EHS completed new TPHC agreement form. CFM marked foods with 4 hour end point of 3:00PM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: observed electric water boiler under hood system with no apparent NSF/ANSI certification plate.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. EHS and CFM discussed that all equipment must be NSF/ANSI certified. CFM will research electric water boiler certification. Until found, CFM will cease use of equipment.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. Observed employee washing hands in 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS discussed proper hand washing with CFM. CFM will educate employees on proper sink in which to wash hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cut cabbage on ice at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM agreed to discard cut cabbage at 1500. EHS discussed using TPHC in the future for cut cabbage and bean sprouts. CFM completed TPHC agreement.

violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the BACK KITCHEN AND ACROSS FROM COOK LINE ARE blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM MOVED MOP BUCKET AND SHELF FROM IN FRONT OF BACK KITCHEN HAND SINK. CFM CLEARED SINK ACROSS FROM COOK LINE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED CONTAINER OF RAW BEEF ON SHELF ABOVE BOXES OF EGG ROLL WRAPPERS
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED BOXES EGG ROLL WRAPPERS TO OTHER SHELF, AWAY FROM RAW BEEF.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED CONTAINER OF OIL AT COOK LINE WITH NO LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM TO LABEL CONTAINER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED CONTAINERS OF FOOD ON FLOORS OF WIC ANF WIF.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM TO MOVE FOODS TO SHELVES OR PURCHASE APPROPRIATE FOOD STORAGE RACK.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM REMOVED SPLITTER ON MOP SINK.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED MOP SINK FAUCET IN POOR REPAIR.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM TO REPAIR/REPLACE MOP FAUCET.
